million-billion-converter.formula:
base = amount x unit multiplier
thousand = base / 1,000
million = base / 1,000,000
billion = base / 1,000,000,000
trillion = base / 1,000,000,000,000
lakh = base / 100,000; crore = base / 10,000,000

keyFacts: 1 million = 1,000 thousand. 1 billion = 1,000 million. 1 trillion = 1,000 billion - each step is x1,000.
The short scale (used in the US, UK, and most of the world) defines billion as 10^9 and trillion as 10^12.
India uses lakh (10^5) and crore (10^7): 1 crore = 10 million, 1 billion = 100 crore.
Most big-number mistakes are dropped or added zeros - always sanity-check the full digit string.
In finance, MM means million and B means billion; k means thousand.
